subject: Order form security exhibit: evidence-rotation ladder, sampling bands, and pen-test SLOs
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@helixhealth.com>, contracts@helixhealth.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form security exhibit: evidence-rotation ladder, sampling bands, and pen-test SLOs

Alex — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Per our discussion, I attached an updated redline (redline_v3.docx) that attempts to strike a balance between Helix's audit needs and our operational constraints. Key proposals in this draft: 

- Evidence rotation ladder: define three tiers (Full, Sampled, Canary) with explicit artifact lists for each tier so we know what to expect when an inspection is triggered.
- Sampling bands: allow Helix to request Full for top-10 tenant-critical endpoints, Sampled for up to 15% of requests, otherwise Canary for weekly aggregated logs.
- Ephemeral access window: standard 48-hour limited inspection for sampled systems with an option to extend to 5 business days for Full reviews (with 48h notice).
- Pen-test SLOs: we propose a pen-test notification + mitigation SLA: vendor submits report within 7 days; Redwood to acknowledge within 48h and provide triage plan within 5 business days.

Two asks from your side to keep momentum: (1) confirm whether Helix needs on-prem staging access during pen tests or if sampled artifacts + ephemeral SCP access will suffice; (2) share any procurement/legal contact to move the order form signatures.

I've copied Ben (Legal) and Karthik (Infra) to confirm internal feasibility. If this approach looks reasonable, I can push the redline to DocuSign and schedule a short triage call for next week.

Cheers,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Contracts | Redwood Inference
(attachment: redline_v3.docx)

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@helixhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@helixhealth.com, security@helixhealth.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form security exhibit: evidence-rotation ladder, sampling bands, and pen-test SLOs

Lauren — thanks for the clear summary and for the redline. Overall this is a helpful framing. A few clarifying points from security and procurement: 

1) Staging access: for regulatory reasons Helix prefers to run pen-tests in a staging environment where possible. If Redwood can provide ephemeral staging creds scoped to the pen-test window, that will satisfy our auditor.

2) Evidence retention: can you confirm retention durations for sampled logs versus full artifacts? Our security team typically expects 90 days for sampled telemetry and 12 months for full forensic exports.

3) SLA language: we need to avoid hard remediation guarantees in the MSA. Can we instead include an operational commitment (acknowledge + triage timeline) and a cross-team escalation path?

I can loop in procurement if the order form amount and term are stable — contracts@helixhealth.com is on CC.

—Alex
Alex Mercer, Sr. InfoSec Manager | Helix Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@helixhealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:53:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form security exhibit: evidence-rotation ladder, sampling bands, and pen-test SLOs

Alex — appreciate the asks. Quick legal notes on the redline: 

- Retention buckets: we can commit to the bucketed durations you requested if we codify them as operational commitments in the security exhibit (non-contractual SLA) rather than a warranty. I'll mark the language in the attached doc and propose an escalation matrix (SOC2 contact / CS lead / Legal escalation).
- Pen-test SLOs: agree — replace any remediation guarantee with a three-step operational response: Acknowledge (48h), Triage plan (5 business days), Status updates weekly until resolution. We'll add binding timelines only for acknowledgement and plan delivery.
- Staging creds: propose a controlled approach — ephemeral staging creds issued via our ticketing system with timeboxed IAM roles and audit logging enabled. Karthik, can infra support that?

If Helix is okay with keeping the retention and SLA language as operational commitments (itemized in the exhibit), we can avoid pulling the MSA core warranty language and keep signature friction low.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
(attachment: redline_v3.docx - legal edits)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@helixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form security exhibit: evidence-rotation ladder, sampling bands, and pen-test SLOs

Ben / Lauren / Alex — quick ops confirmation from infra:

- Ephemeral staging creds are straightforward. We can generate time-limited IAM roles scoped to the test harness; access will be logged and we can produce session recordings for Full reviews.
- Evidence exports: for Full reviews we can produce up to 12 months of forensic exports (compressed) but it will require a 72-hour prep window to gather and scrub any PII per our data handling policy. For Sampled buckets, we can offer 90-day retention for aggregated telemetry export via shared Drive link.
- Pen-test scheduling: attached is a proposed cadence (pen-test-schedule.xlsx). We recommend a 2-week notice for Full tests to allow prep/ephemeral account issuance; Sampled audits may be scheduled with 48h notice.

Operational ask: if Helix intends to run an external pentester, we require a mutual action plan (MUTUAL-ACTION-ALERT) and a signed statement of scope from the tester.

Happy to sync on a 30-min technical bridge to walk through the access controls.

—Karthik
Director, Infra & Reliability | Redwood Inference
(attachment: pen-test-schedule.xlsx)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@helixhealth.com>, contracts@helixhealth.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form security exhibit: evidence-rotation ladder, sampling bands, and pen-test SLOs

Alex / team — thanks for the speedy review and helpful feedback. Summary of agreed items and next steps: 

1) Retention & buckets: Helix will be documented as 90 days (Sampled) / 12 months (Full) in the security exhibit as operational commitments (non-warranty). Ben will finalize wording to keep this out of core MSA warranties.
2) Staging & ephemeral creds: Redwood infra can provide time-limited staging roles and audit logs. Karthik to run a 30-min tech bridge (calendar invite to follow).
3) Pen-test cadence & scope: Full tests require 2-week notice + signed scope; Sampled audits 48h notice. Redwood requests a MUTUAL-ACTION-ALERT and scope statement for external testers.
4) SLA framing: Acknowledge (48h) and Triage plan (5 business days) will be included in the exhibit. No hard remediation warranty.

If procurement is comfortable, I will: (a) accept these redlines into the order form, (b) upload the final exhibit to the Drive folder (link below), and (c) send the order form to DocuSign. Please confirm and I’ll send the DocuSign envelope today.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDef-Helix-Evidence
DocuSign prefill: https://www.docusign.net/helix/EnvelopeID12345

Thanks — looping in contracts@helixhealth.com to confirm signatures and payment terms.

Lauren
Head of Customer Contracts | Redwood Inference
(attachment: redline_v3.docx)
